shared_elements: low-relief carved frieze with figures on a groundline
quadruped animals in profile facing right
horned/maned animal heads rendered in detail
justification: Both are shallow-relief horizontal friezes with bearded human figures and profile quadrupeds moving in a single direction along a groundline, with careful patterned rendering of fleece/mane and hair. But the subjects differ substantially: A is a calm procession of men leading rams beside a tree, while B is a dynamic hunt with a chariot, galloping horses, archers and wounded lions, so the specific relationships (leading a docile animal vs shooting a beast from a moving vehicle) are unrelated.
